tools.name: sponsor_search
tools.description: Search sponsors by name, description, industry tags, or filters. Returns compact results (id, name, tagline = what the brand sells in a few words, website, niches, industryTags, country, operations, medianSubscribers). Use sponsor_get for full detail on a specific sponsor.

tools.name: sponsor_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific sponsor by ID. Strips raw scrape data and llm internal analysis blobs.

tools.name: sponsor_stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a sponsor: number of YouTubers, median subscribers, operations per week/month/year

tools.name: sponsor_similar
tools.description: Find sponsors similar to a given sponsor based on industry tags and niches. Returns compact format.

tools.name: sponsor_youtubers
tools.description: Get YouTubers who have worked with a sponsor. Returns compact format.

tools.name: sponsor_mostActive
tools.description: Get the most active sponsors in a given period (week/month/year), optionally filtered by language. Returns compact format.

tools.name: sponsor_recentVideos
tools.description: Get the most recent sponsored videos from a sponsor, ordered by publication date

tools.name: sponsor_recentCollaborations
tools.description: Get the most recent collaboration (one video per YouTuber) with a sponsor, sorted by publication date

tools.name: youtuber_search
tools.description: Search YouTubers with advanced filters: subscribers, language, niches, sponsors worked with, monthly frequency, etc. All filters combine with AND — including hasWorkedWith, which keeps only creators who worked with EVERY listed domain. tools.name: youtuber_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific YouTuber by their YouTube channel ID. Includes llmDescription and llmSponsorProfile (LLM-friendly summaries), lastAnalyzedAt (when sponsors were last detected on the channel — every channel is re-scanned weekly; use youtuber_refresh if it is older than 7 day

tools.name: youtuber_sponsors
tools.description: Get sponsors a YouTuber has worked with, including video counts for each sponsor. Sorted by most recent sponsored video first (sortBy=lastVideo, default) or by first collaboration (sortBy=firstVideo). Paginated: use offset with limit (max 50 per page) and hasMore to walk big channels. Returns compac

tools.name: youtuber_recentSponsored
tools.description: Get the most recent sponsored videos from a YouTuber, with one video per sponsor (sorted by publication date)

tools.name: youtuber_similar
tools.description: Find YouTubers similar to a given YouTuber based on content, niches, and sponsors. Returns compact format.

tools.name: youtuber_lastActiveBiggest
tools.description: Get the biggest YouTubers who have been active recently (last 15 days) for a specific language. Returns compact format.

tools.name: youtuber_add
tools.description: Add a single YouTuber to the database and trigger the full enrichment pipeline (tags, niches, description, similarity, sponsor detection). Returns a batchId you can poll with import_status. Prefer passing a channel ID (UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, 24 chars) — handles ('@xxx') and URLs work too but cost

tools.name: youtuber_bulk_add
tools.description: Add up to 50 YouTubers in one call and trigger enrichment for each. Returns a batchId you can poll with import_status. Strongly prefer channel IDs (UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, 24 chars) over handles/URLs — handles cost an extra YouTube API quota point each, which depletes the daily 10k budget faster.

tools.name: youtuber_refresh
tools.description: Re-run sponsor detection on a YouTuber already in the database (latest videos). Costs 50 requests of your monthly MCP quota. tools.name: youtuber_fullAnalysis
tools.description: Agent plan only. Run sponsor detection on the ENTIRE video history of a YouTuber already in the database (not just the latest videos like youtuber_refresh), and re-check older automatic rejections with the current detection pipeline — use it when youtuber_sponsors looks incomplete for a channel with

tools.name: import_status
tools.description: Poll the progress of a bulk import batch by its batchId. Returns total/queued/done/failed counts plus startedAt/finishedAt timestamps. Batches expire after 7 days.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "youtuber_fullAnalysis" is 710 chars, far longer than this server's median (122). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sponsor_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
